note: Reader-facing glossary for subsite margin definitions. One entry per term. atlas/GLOSSARY.md remains the atlas jurisdiction glossary and is not this file.

terms.definition: The name of this subsite. It spans the Niagara area across New York and Ontario. It is not Niagara Region, the Ontario upper-tier municipality.
The official upper-tier municipality of twelve lower-tier municipalities in Ontario. Not a name for the wider Niagara area, and not the name of a subsite.

The editorial name for opportunity: shared interests among parties that could enable action, investment, and growth. The Overlaps section is not a data-derived rule list, and a subsite may use it lightly.
A lens over shared place data: a set of regions, a topic list, any extra sections that subsite defines, and a landing page.

The name of this subsite. It is a technical scaffold for the HeavyMap tool: industrial intelligence for the cross-border Niagara area, assembled from public data. It is not Niagara Region, the Ontario upper-tier municipality.
